description: This file defines a React component named UserProfileModal that renders an accessible, responsive modal displaying core user profile information such as name, email, department, and tenant ID. It includes focus management, keyboard trap logic, and styling for a read-only user profile view.

methods.name: getFocusableElements
methods.description: Returns an array of focusable and visible elements within a given root element.

methods.name: trapTabKey
methods.description: Handles focus trapping within the modal by cycling focus between focusable elements when Tab or Shift+Tab is pressed.
